text:
Mina: Opening a PR to merge three Console observability snippets into a single 'wiring' guide: heatmap generation, tracehook stitching, and cost/latency panel migration. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/18901
DocsBot: docs-bot: PR 18901 opened by Mina. Lint & CI queued.
Theo: I'll take the TypeScript/Node samples and add a tiny helper that tries base64 (standard and urlsafe) then hex. Will add unit tests for header precedence.
Rhea: I'll own Python and a pytest covering new, legacy, and absent-trace cases. I'll also add the dashboard mapping snippet for routing_ms + decode_ms.
Ally: UX note: we need to call out that p90/p99 are now separate metrics. Also add a short Dedicated-customer billing caveat about bucket resolution causing small temporary reallocation of costs.
Jon: Small ops note: some on-prem proxies rewrite headers to lowercase or prefix them; include an nginx snippet showing how to preserve/forward `trace_key` as `X-Forwarded-Trace`.
Mina: Header precedence we suggest: prefer `trace_key` -> `x-rd-trace` -> `x-forwarded-trace` -> infer from `span-id`. Add fallback caveat.
Theo: TS helper draft:
```ts
function resolveTrace(headers: Record<string,string|undefined>) {
  const raw = headers['trace_key'] || headers['x-rd-trace'] || headers['x-forwarded-trace'];
  return tryBase64(raw) || tryUrlSafeBase64(raw) || tryHex(raw) || inferFromSpan(headers['span-id']);
}
```
Rhea: Python preview:
```py
raw = headers.get('trace_key') or headers.get('x-rd-trace') or headers.get('x-forwarded-trace')
trace = try_base64(raw) or try_urlsafe_base64(raw) or try_hex(raw) or infer_from_span(headers.get('span-id'))
client.generate(input, trace={'trace_key': trace})
```
Jon: Nginx snippet to forward header:
```
proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Trace $http_trace_key;
proxy_pass http://upstream;
```
Add under Private deployment notes.
Ally: Migration blurb: "If you used a single latency metric, sum routing_ms + decode_ms for legacy baselines. p90/p99 are now separate; update dashboards accordingly." Added a mapping table and example monitoring query for unit-cost alerts.
DocsBot: docs-bot: running link-check post-CI. Scanning 8 pages. Found 2 redirects and 0 broken links.
Theo: Pushed TS + tests. Tests cover new header, legacy header, and missing header fallback. Also included a comment about avoiding synchronous heavy decode in hot paths.
Rhea: Pushed pytest and dashboard mapping examples. Reworded the UX copy per Ally's suggestion.
Mina: Merge plan: wait for CI & link-check green, then squash+merge and backport a compatibility snippet to `stable-legacy`. I'll post a heads-up in #release-war-room before merge. Target: next Tue morning.
DocsBot: docs-bot: CI passed. link-check: rerun shows redirects resolved.
Jon: I'll open a tiny redirect PR for any remaining old example links if needed.
Theo: LGTM, will address any follow-up nits after editorial.
Rhea: Thanks all 8 will update the changelog blurb after merge.
Mina: Appreciate the quick turnaround; will follow up on rollout notes and customer comms.
